newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: Salvador attack leaves one dead, three injured.
newsitem.headline: Salvador attack leaves one dead, three injured.

text.p: One person was killed and three others were wounded when a grenade was lobbed at a crowd of leftist political supporters on Friday, further increasing tension ahead of next week's national elections, police said on Saturday.

Jose Franco, 17, and several other activists of the leftist Farabundo Marti Front for National Liberation (FMLN) were handing out election propaganda when the grenade exploded. Franco later died of his wounds.
Police said they were focusing on two suspects but had so far not made any arrests.
Franco's death was the third in as many weeks due to rising tension between supporters of the FMLN and its former civil war adversaries, the right-wing National Republican Alliance (Arena) party.
Both sides have accused each other of promoting violence ahead of the election of 84 new congressional deputies and 262 mayors.
Arena said on Friday that six of its members had been injured during a scuffle with FMLN supporters in the San Salvador suburb of San Martin.
The elections will only be the second time this nation of 3 million have voted since the 1992 end of the country's 12-year civil war, which claimed at least 75,000 lives.
